info.title: Aiperator Trust Fabric Search
info.description: ATF semantic search service backed by PostgreSQL + pgvector. Supports dense, hybrid (dense + PostgreSQL FTS/ts_rank + SPLADE), and FTS-only search with optional cross-encoder reranking, HyDE query expansion, document versioning, and fine-grained access control.

tags.name: MCP
tags.description: Model Context Protocol — Streamable HTTP transport for LLM agents

BearerToken.description: API token set via the API_TOKEN environment variable.

base_ref.description: Parent document reference (equals reference for non-chunked docs)

metadata.description: Canonical optional fields: project_id, case_id, document_id, document_type, document_date (ISO), version, supersedes, author, recipient, confidentiality, page, section, attachment_of, ocr_quality (0..1). Unknown keys are preserved.

chunk.description: Chunk-technical metadata (chunk_index, chunk_total, chunk_id, char_start/char_end, hierarchy and optional page span)

evidence.description: Citation coordinates and optional image evidence identity.

asset_url.description: Relative authenticated URL for the original figure image.

valid_from.description: Explicit business-validity start, or null for legacy rows.

revision_id.description: Revision of the hit (v2 revision pipeline); absent for legacy v1 rows.

truncated.description: group_by_document only: the document group reached SEARCH_GROUP_MAX_CHUNKS_PER_DOCUMENT and chunks were dropped.

omitted_chunks.description: group_by_document only: number of chunks dropped by the per-document cap.

score_kind.description: Kind of the final scores: reranker score when reranking was applied, retrieval score otherwise. See score_scale for the exact scale.

score_scale.description: Exact scale of the final scores. They are not comparable across scales: rerank is the reranker score on [0,1] (native or sigmoid per RERANK_SCORE_TRANSFORM), cosine a similarity, rrf a pool-relative fusion score (≈0.016 per list), fts a lexical rank.

threshold_scale.description: Scale the threshold was set for (MIN_RERANK_SCORE is always rerank).

skipped.description: Present when the threshold was not applied because the final scores are on another scale (e.g. the reranker fell back); results are then unfiltered.

candidates.description: Number of results before the threshold filter.

kept.description: Number of results at or above the threshold.

abstain.description: True when no result reached the threshold.

missingRanges.description: Page ranges still missing (commit / segment completeness errors).

get.description: Returns 200 when the service and database are reachable. No auth required.
Process liveness only — never checks dependencies, so a slow database does not cause restart loops. Always 200.
Gates the load balancer on the database, the source of truth for every request path. Model probes stay in /health so a degraded model does not remove the replica.

get.summary: Public key for signed evidence packs
get.description: JWKS with the Ed25519 public key that verifies the `signature` of verified evidence packs. 404 while `SEARCH_EVIDENCE_SIGNING_KEY` is unset. No auth required.

404.description: Evidence pack signing is not configured

post.summary: Exchange API token for a session cookie
post.description: Used by the browser test page. Sends the token in the request body and sets a secure session cookie.

Embeds the request body and queries the vector index. Supports dense, hybrid (RRF), and FTS-only modes, optional synchronous or async SSE reranking, HyDE query expansion, metadata / tag / user-group filtering, and keyset pagination.

parameters.name: X-Collection
parameters.description: Target collection name. Default: `documents`.

parameters.name: X-Max-Results
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–100). Default: 10.

parameters.name: X-Offset
parameters.description: Legacy offset-based pagination. Prefer `X-Cursor` for large datasets.

parameters.name: X-Cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor returned as `next_cursor` from the previous page.

parameters.name: X-Search-Mode
parameters.description: Search strategy. `dense` = cosine only, `hybrid` = RRF, `fts` = PostgreSQL FTS/ts_rank only. Overrides `X-Hybrid`.

parameters.name: X-Hybrid
parameters.description: Enable hybrid search (RRF). Ignored when X-Search-Mode is set.

parameters.name: X-Rerank
parameters.description: Reranking mode: falsy = off, truthy = synchronous, `async` = SSE stream.

parameters.name: X-Hyde
parameters.description: Expand the query with a hypothetical document before embedding (requires HYDE_MODEL).

parameters.name: X-Include-All-Versions
parameters.description: Orthogonal version switch: without X-Valid-At returns all versions; with X-Valid-At returns all versions whose effective validity start is at or before the instant.

parameters.name: X-Valid-At
parameters.description: RFC 3339 instant with explicit timezone. With include-all=false selects one as-of version per logical document; with true keeps every version effective by this instant.

parameters.name: X-Include-Query-Vector
parameters.description: Return the query embedding vector in the response (adds ~12–64 KB).

parameters.name: X-Filter
parameters.description: Additional legacy JSON metadata equality filter merged with any X-Metadata filter. Example: `{"product":"acme"}`.

parameters.name: X-Filter-V2
parameters.description: Additive canonical metadata filter with eq/in/range operators, e.g. `{"eq":{"case_id":"c-1"},"range":{"document_date":{"gte":"2025-01-01"}}}`.

parameters.name: X-Tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of tags; documents must contain ALL listed tags.

parameters.name: X-Base-Ref
parameters.description: Restrict results to chunks of a specific base document. Returns chunks in order.

parameters.name: X-User
parameters.description: User ID for access-control filtering (returns docs where allowed_users contains this ID).

parameters.name: X-Groups
parameters.description: Comma-separated group IDs; returns docs where allowed_groups overlaps.

parameters.name: X-Metadata
parameters.description: JSON object of metadata key/value pairs used as an equality filter.

200.description: Search results. When `X-Rerank: async` is used, returns `text/event-stream` with `results`, `rerank`, and `done` events.

X-Query-Truncated.description: `true` when the query was cut to SEARCH_MAX_QUERY_CHARS before searching.

next_cursor.description: Pass as X-Cursor to fetch the next page.

hyde_query.description: The HyDE-expanded query text, if HyDE was applied.

score_scale.description: Scale of the result scores (always present). Scales are not comparable: rerank is the reranker's score (native [0,1] kept, otherwise sigmoid; see RERANK_SCORE_TRANSFORM), cosine a similarity, rrf a pool-relative fusion score, fts a lexical rank.

content_trust.description: Always `untrusted`: result text comes from ingested documents and is data, never instructions.

injection_risk.description: Heuristic hint: `suspected` when any hit contains well-known prompt-override phrasing. `none` does not mean safe.

abstention.description: MIN_RERANK_SCORE abstention signal (only when a threshold is configured).

post.description: Evaluates an in-memory, tenant- and exact body.collection-ACL-scoped golden set with production search defaults; X-Collection is ignored. Supports a version label, deterministic dataset provenance hash and optional release thresholds; no qrels or query text are persisted.

cutoffs.description: Metrics cutoffs; retrieval runs once to the maximum

valid_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 as-of instant with explicit timezone

200.description: Metrics, effective retrieval parameters, deterministic dataset provenance hash and optional release-gate result

dataset.description: Client version label plus server-computed SHA-256 over the canonical bounded qrels input

403.description: Tenant, scope or exact body collection denied

post.description: Embeds and stores a single document or, when chunking is configured, splits it into chunks first. Supports versioning, sparse vectors, semantic chunking, late chunking, and LLM-based summarization. Structured summary/page/figure/table extraction applies when chunking is enabled.

parameters.description: Select embedded/generated summary precedence. `generate` permits generation but still requires X-Summarize=true and a configured SUMMARY_MODEL.

parameters.name: X-Extract-Contract
parameters.description: Producer's extract-contract id (e.g. atf-extract/1.1.0). Optional; when present it must be a v1 marker-grammar id — an incompatible major is rejected with HTTP 400.

parameters.name: X-Allowed-Users
parameters.description: Comma-separated user IDs that may read this document.

parameters.name: X-Allowed-Groups
parameters.description: Comma-separated group IDs that may read this document.

parameters.name: X-Metadata
parameters.description: JSON metadata object to attach to the document.

post.summary: Ingest a binary document by starting a v2 extraction job
post.description:
Accepts a raw PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, PNG, JPEG, GIF, TIFF, BMP or WebP, uploads it to `@atf/extract`'s content-addressed source store and starts a v2 extraction job. Returns **202** with the job id; poll `GET {converter}/v2/jobs/{id}` for progress.

The job's emitter streams the extracted revision **and figure assets** back into this service's revision API, so figure images are now stored and openable in search results — the earlier `X-Figure-Assets: not-stored` limitation no longer applies.

Mounted only when `CONVERTER_URL` is configured; otherwise this route returns 404.

parameters.name: X-Reference
parameters.description: Document identity. Validated before the conversion is paid for.

parameters.name: X-Collection
parameters.description: Target collection for the job's revision.

requestBody.description: The raw document, sent with its own Content-Type.

202.description: Accepted; a v2 extraction job was started. The body carries the job id and a poll path, and the Location header points at the job on Extract.

Location.description: Absolute URL of the created job on Extract.

400.description: Missing X-Reference, empty body, or invalid headers

422.description: The document exceeds Extract's page limit

502.description: Extract or the upload/job call failed

504.description: Extract did not respond within CONVERTER_TIMEOUT_MS

post.summary: Ingest a batch of documents (JSON array)
post.description: Accepts a JSON array of document objects. Embeddings are computed in a single batch call. Each document may override chunking options via per-document fields.

valid_from.description: Per-document value overrides X-Valid-From; null explicitly uses the created-time fallback.

parameters.name: X-Valid-From
parameters.description: Shared RFC 3339 validity start; per-document valid_from overrides it.

parameters.name: X-Semantic-Chunking
parameters.description: Use semantic chunking for all documents in the batch.

parameters.name: X-Page-Markers
parameters.description: Extract Markdown page markers.

parameters.name: X-Figure-Chunks

parameters.name: X-Normalize-Tables
parameters.description: Convert HTML tables to Markdown.

parameters.name: X-Extract-Contract
parameters.description: Producer's extract-contract id (e.g. atf-extract/1.1.0). Optional; an incompatible major is rejected with HTTP 400.

post.description: Accepts a newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) body where each line is a document object (same shape as the ingest-batch array items). Designed for large bulk imports up to the `STREAM_BODY_LIMIT` (default 50 MB). Documents are processed and embedded in batches.

schema.description: One JSON document object per line.

parameters.name: X-Valid-From
parameters.description: Shared RFC 3339 validity start; per-document valid_from overrides it.

parameters.name: X-Page-Markers

parameters.description: Producer's extract-contract id (e.g. atf-extract/1.1.0). Optional; an incompatible major is rejected with HTTP 400.

delete.summary: Delete documents by reference or metadata filter
delete.description: Deletes all chunks belonging to the given reference (including all versions), or all documents matching the metadata filter when no reference is supplied.

parameters.name: X-Reference
parameters.description: Delete by exact reference (and all its chunks/versions).

parameters.name: X-Metadata
parameters.description: JSON metadata filter — delete all matching documents.

post.summary: Erase subject, reference, or tenant data (DSAR)
post.description: Removes documents identified by the request scope — a data subject (allowed_users ACL or the configurable subject metadata field), explicit references (full document cascade), or an entire tenant — plus the subject's or tenant's rows in the search-stats buffer. Requires the `vectorsearch.erasure` scope. Idempotent over `requestId`: a repeated request with the same payload returns the stored result; the same `requestId` with a different payload is rejected with 409. Per-store results are reported honestly: 200 when every store succeeded, 207 when some failed, 502 when all failed.

parameters.name: X-Collection
parameters.description: Restrict the erasure to this collection. Without it, every collection visible to the credential is erased.

requestId.description: Idempotency key for this erasure request.

subject.description: Identifiers of the data subject. Required (at least one) for scope=subject.

references.description: Document references. Required (at least one) for scope=reference.

dryRun.description: Count what would be erased without deleting.

200.description: Every store succeeded (or replay of a done request)

207.description: Some stores failed — per-store results included

403.description: Missing vectorsearch.erasure scope or tenant mismatch

409.description: requestId reused with a different payload, or still in flight

get.description: Lists the documents in a collection (grouped by base_ref), newest first, optionally restricted to a folder path prefix. Paginated.

parameters.name: path_prefix
parameters.description: Restrict to documents beneath this folder, e.g. "/Unterlagen Teil 1".

get.summary: Fetch a document reassembled from its chunks
get.description: Returns a whole document (chunks joined in order, overlaps trimmed). Large documents are windowed via max_chars/offset — check the `truncated` flag.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Document reference/path (base_ref) or any chunk reference.

get.summary: Reassemble every document beneath a folder
get.description: Reads a whole folder in one call, each document reassembled from its chunks. Bounded by limit and max_chars; check the `truncated` flag.

parameters.name: path_prefix
parameters.description: Folder whose documents to read, e.g. "/Unterlagen Teil 1".

get.summary: List sub-folders beneath a folder path
get.description: Derives the folder structure from document reference paths, each folder with a recursive document count, plus how many documents lie directly at the prefix.

parameters.name: path_prefix
parameters.description: Folder to list, e.g. "/Unterlagen Teil 1". Omit or "/" for the top level.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Folder levels below the prefix: 1 (default) = immediate children; n>1 = up to n levels; 0/negative = whole sub-tree.

get.summary: Fetch the stored summary of one document
get.description: Returns the document's stored summary/prefix (generated at ingest time). Cheaper than /document when you only need the gist.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Document reference/path (base_ref) or any chunk reference.

get.description: The cheap overview of a whole collection/folder — one summary per document, optionally restricted to a folder path prefix. Paginated.

get.summary: Count documents and chunks in a collection
get.description: Aggregate document/chunk counts, optionally scoped to a folder path prefix. Answers 'how many documents are in the collection / in this folder'.

delete.summary: Drop a collection and all its data

post.description: Renames the collection table and updates all associated indexes and the collection config row in a single transaction. Returns 404 when the source collection does not exist.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Current collection name

new_name.description: New collection name (must be a valid identifier)

400.description: Invalid name or same name supplied

get.description: Returns low-cardinality HTTP counters, in-flight gauge, request-duration histogram, ingest/search counters and runtime metrics in Prometheus text format. Requires `vectorsearch.metrics` when authorization enforcement is enabled.

post.summary: MCP Streamable HTTP — initialize or send a tool call
post.description: Model Context Protocol Streamable HTTP transport (spec 2025-03-26). A POST without `Mcp-Session-Id` initializes a new session and returns the session ID. Subsequent POSTs with `Mcp-Session-Id` execute tool calls. Available tools: `search`, `ingest`, `delete_document`, `list_collections`, `collection_stats`, `list_documents`, `list_folders`, `get_document`, `get_documents`, `get_summary`, `get_summaries`.

parameters.name: Mcp-Session-Id
parameters.description: Session ID returned during initialization. Omit for the first (init) request.

get.summary: MCP Streamable HTTP — open SSE notification stream
get.description: Opens a persistent SSE stream for server-to-client notifications. Requires an active session ID.

post.summary: Stateless MCP 2026 tool discovery and invocation
post.description: MCP 2026-07-28 stateless HTTP transport. All requests require Bearer authentication, MCP-Protocol-Version, a matching body protocol-version meta field and Mcp-Method; tools/call additionally requires Mcp-Name. Transaction tokens may be supplied in X-Transaction-Token or params._meta[transaction/token]. Errors are JSON-RPC errors: HeaderMismatch (-32020), UnsupportedProtocolVersion (-32022), transaction failures (-32001), access denied (-32003), deadline exceeded (-32008), invalid arguments (-32602), unknown tool (-32601), internal error (-32603).

parameters.name: Mcp-Name
parameters.description: Required for tools/call and equal to params.name.

parameters.name: X-Transaction-Token
parameters.description: Optional for discovery; required for protected calls when transaction enforcement is required.

400.description: Header, protocol, validation or transaction request failure

post.summary: Open (or re-open) a revision for a document
post.description: Accepts an `Idempotency-Key`; a repeat with the same key returns the same revision rather than a second one. `visibility` (`progressive|on_commit`) defaults per new document versus replace. The revision is authorized against the caller's tenant, collection ACL and row ACL, like /ingest.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: URL-encoded document reference.

parameters.name: X-Source-Id
parameters.description: The source claim registered with `POST /v2/sources/identify` (Extract sends its job id). The final commit marks that source indexed.

parameters.name: X-Allowed-Users
parameters.description: Comma-separated users who may read the document's units (row ACL). Taken as given from a service caller (Extract narrows it to the uploading user); an end-user caller can only narrow to its own identity. Without X-Allowed-Users/-Groups a service write gets the collection ACL, else no row restriction.

parameters.name: X-Allowed-Groups
parameters.description: Comma-separated groups who may read the document's units (see X-Allowed-Users).

200.description: Existing revision returned for a repeated Idempotency-Key

409.description: The Idempotency-Key was already used for a revision of a different document. Codes: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`.

500.description: The revision could not be created. Codes: `REVISION_CREATE_FAILED`.

503.description: Database unreachable; retry with the same Idempotency-Key. Codes: `POSTGRES_UNREACHABLE`.

get.description: Accepted batch ranges, processed page ranges, missing assets, committed segments, the revision status and the commit state (a commit answered with 202 shows as pending until its staged batches are processed) (Requirement 5.6).

409.description: The revision belongs to a different document reference. Codes: `REVISION_REFERENCE_MISMATCH`.

delete.summary: Abort an uncommitted revision by id

200.description: Aborted; the revision's staged data is cleaned up with it.

409.description: The revision is already committed, or belongs to a different document reference. Codes: `REVISION_COMMITTED`, `REVISION_REFERENCE_MISMATCH`.

put.description: Requires a `Content-Digest`. The same `seq` with the same digest is a **200** no-op; a different digest is a **409**. Records are validated through the contract, then staged durably before being acknowledged (Requirements 5.2, 5.3).

requestBody.description: The batch as NDJSON contract records; bounded by REVISION_BATCH_BODY_LIMIT.

200.description: Batch staged, or a no-op repeat

400.description: Missing/invalid Content-Digest, digest does not match the body, or an invalid X-Extract-Contract header. Codes: `INVALID_CONTENT_DIGEST`, `CONTENT_DIGEST_MISMATCH`, `INVALID_EXTRACT_CONTRACT`.

409.description: Same seq with a different digest; the revision is closed or its final commit was already accepted (no further batches); the revision belongs to a different document reference; or a concurrent PUT of the same seq could not be resolved (retry). Codes: `BATCH_DIGEST_CONFLICT`, `REVISION_CLOSED`, `REVISION_COMMIT_PENDING`, `REVISION_REFERENCE_MISMATCH`, `BATCH_CONFLICT`.

422.description: A record failed contract validation (the body lists the `issues`), or the X-Extract-Contract major is incompatible. Codes: `BATCH_VALIDATION_FAILED`, `INCOMPATIBLE_EXTRACT_CONTRACT`.

503.description: Database unreachable; retry the same seq and digest. Codes: `POSTGRES_UNREACHABLE`.

post.description: Idempotent. Under progressive visibility the segment's pages become searchable at commit.

409.description: Missing batches (the body lists `missingRanges`), a segment without pages, a closed revision, or a revision of a different document reference. Codes: `SEGMENT_MISSING_BATCHES`, `SEGMENT_NO_PAGES`, `REVISION_CLOSED`, `REVISION_REFERENCE_MISMATCH`.

503.description: The segment is committed but its visibility flip did not complete, or the database is unreachable; retry (idempotent). Codes: `SEGMENT_FLIP_INCOMPLETE`, `POSTGRES_UNREACHABLE`.

post.summary: Final commit — atomically switch the visible revision
post.description: Idempotent. Rejected with **409** and the list of missing ranges when batches are outstanding. On success the document's revision pointer is switched so search never sees two revisions at once (Requirements 5.9, 5.11, 6.5). When staged batches are still being processed the commit is accepted durably and answered with **202** (`pending: true`, `isLatest: false`); the previous revision stays visible until the worker finishes the switch. Repeat the call or poll the revision status to observe it.

202.description: Commit accepted and durable, switch pending: staged batches are still being processed (`pending: true`, `isLatest: false`). The previous revision stays visible.

409.description: Incomplete revision (the body lists `missingRanges`): pages missing for the declared page count, page count unknown and no `document.end` staged, or no batches at all; or the revision is closed / belongs to a different document reference. Codes: `COMMIT_MISSING_BATCHES`, `COMMIT_DOCUMENT_END_MISSING`, `COMMIT_NO_BATCHES`, `REVISION_CLOSED`, `REVISION_REFERENCE_MISMATCH`.

503.description: The commit was accepted but the final switch could not complete yet (it is resumed automatically), or the database is unreachable; retry (idempotent). Codes: `COMMIT_FINALIZE_INCOMPLETE`, `POSTGRES_UNREACHABLE`.

post.description: A paused job heartbeats to keep an uncommitted revision from being TTL-swept (Requirement 5.10).

404.description: No such revision, or it can no longer be extended (committed / aborted / superseded). Codes: `REVISION_NOT_EXTENDABLE`.

409.description: The final commit was already accepted (no TTL to extend), or the revision belongs to a different document reference. Codes: `REVISION_COMMIT_PENDING`, `REVISION_REFERENCE_MISMATCH`.

post.summary: Register an ingest's source and detect duplicates
post.description: Registers (or updates) the source claim of one ingest and decides whether it is `new`, a `new_version` of an indexed document, or a `duplicate` to skip. A document is identified by its reference without file extension (`documentKey`), so another format of an indexed document resolves to the reference the document is indexed under (`canonicalReference`). Exact duplicates (same file sha256, same normalised text hash, same e-mail Message-ID) are detected collection-wide; near-duplicates (MinHash similarity) only among sources of the same document key, and only when their versions match (or are unknown and the texts are nearly identical). Called in two phases: `source` (hash only) and `content` (fingerprint, version). Idempotent per `sourceId`.

get.summary: List every source of a document
get.description: The files a document was ingested from — indexed ones and those skipped as duplicates of it (e.g. the DOCX export of an indexed PDF) — oldest first, with version and match details. Only sources whose row ACL admits the caller are listed.

get.summary: Compare a document's units between two points in time
get.description: Loads the document's units at both time points and aligns them by section, then unit id, then reading order. Units only in the later point are added, units only in the earlier point are removed, units whose content differs are changed (with before/after excerpts of at most 300 characters); the rest are counted as unchanged_count. Only units whose ACL admits the caller are compared.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Earlier point in time (RFC 3339).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Later point in time (RFC 3339).

200.description: The unit-level diff between the two time points

truncated.description: True when either point in time holds more units than one read loads; the diff then covers only the first units in reading order.

post.summary: Check cited chunks against the current document revision
post.description: For each cited chunk (`base_ref` plus the `chunk_id` a search hit carried as evidence — the v1 chunk id or the v2 unit id), report whether it is `current` (part of the revision visible today), `carried` (an older revision, but its exact content exists unchanged in the current revision), `changed` (an older revision, content no longer present), `removed` (the document has no revision visible to the caller today), or `unknown` (no chunk with that id is visible to the caller). The visibility rule for today is the same temporal rule as the document diff with `valid_at = now`; only chunks the caller's ACL admits are ever considered. Results come back in the request's item order.

collection.description: Target collection; falls back to ?collection= or the X-Collection header.

200.description: The verdict for each citation, in input order

400.description: Invalid request body (items missing or out of range)

put.summary: Upload an asset, idempotent by checksum, bound to a revision
put.description: Idempotent by the asset checksum. The asset is bound to the `revision` and is cleaned up with it. Stored through the configured AssetStore backend (postgres BYTEA or filesystem); `thumb`/`preview` variants are derived server-side.

200.description: Already present with the same checksum

post.summary: Semantic search v2 (structured hits, assets, navigation)
post.description: Runs the v2 retrieval pipeline (identifier RRF → hybrid candidates → rerank-with-context → diversify → small-to-big expansion → asset attach) and returns structured hits with `section_path`, `pages`, `expanded`, `assets[]`, `navigation` and `evidence`. The v1 `/search` endpoint is unchanged.

parameters.name: X-Collection
parameters.description: Target collection name. Default: `documents`.

parameters.name: X-Valid-At
parameters.description: RFC 3339 instant with explicit timezone. Selects the version valid at that instant for the candidates and the expansion, as on `/search`.

expand.description: Small-to-big expansion. `document` returns the hit's whole document in reading order — for an e-mail the whole thread chronologically (default budget 50000).

hyde.description: Embed a hypothetical answer document for the query (HyDE) instead of the query itself; needs a HYDE model configured server-side. The lexical branch and the reranker keep the original query. The response reports the outcome as `hyde_applied`.

group_by.description: Merge hits of the same document / section into one result with the best score and the merged content; the result carries `group` (Requirement 13.6). Lifts the per-section diversity cap. `document` merges an e-mail thread (messages ingested independently, threaded by Message-ID / References) into one result, chronologically; combine with `expand=document` for the full thread text.

identifier_search.description: Fuse the identifier list (exact `vs_identifiers` hits + `ts_ident` lexical matches for codes such as `WE-01/A`) as an additional RRF list (Requirement 12.3). Hybrid mode only; `false` opts out.

revision_state.description: Present when the hit comes from a still-growing progressive revision.

pages_available.description: Committed page ranges of a partial revision, e.g. `1–2750`.

group.description: Present when `group_by` merged several hits into this one.

score_scale.description: Scale of the result scores (always present). Scales are not comparable: rerank is the reranker's score (native [0,1] kept, otherwise sigmoid; see RERANK_SCORE_TRANSFORM), cosine a similarity, rrf a pool-relative fusion score, fts a lexical rank.

content_trust.description: Always `untrusted`: result text comes from ingested documents and is data, never instructions.

injection_risk.description: Heuristic hint: `suspected` when any hit contains well-known prompt-override phrasing. `none` does not mean safe.

abstention.description: MIN_RERANK_SCORE abstention signal (only when a threshold is configured).

query_truncated.description: Present (true) when the query was cut to SEARCH_MAX_QUERY_CHARS before searching.

hyde_applied.description: Present when `hyde` was requested: whether the hypothetical answer document was actually used for the embedding (false when no HYDE model is configured or the expansion failed).

400.description: Invalid parameters or filters, or an invalid collection name (INVALID_COLLECTION_NAME)

post.summary: Answer-ready retrieval (question → evidence within a token budget)
post.description: The HTTP twin of the MCP tool `retrieve_for_answer`. The question is split into sub-questions by rule (cut at `?`, `;`, ` und `, ` sowie `, ` and `, ` as well as ` where both sides have at least three words), or — with `decomposition: "llm"` and a configured decomposition model — by that model, falling back to the rules when its answer is unusable; the response names the method used. Each sub-question is searched, the ranked lists are fused by reciprocal rank (`Σ 1/(60+rank)`), repeated chunks and near-duplicate texts are removed, the top 50 are reranked against the original question when a reranker is configured, and the passages are packed into `budget_tokens` (at most 3 per document; a passage that does not fit is skipped, never cut). All text is untrusted data (`content_trust`, `injection_risk` per passage and overall).

parameters.name: X-Collection
parameters.description: Target collection name. Default: `documents`.

parameters.name: X-Valid-At
parameters.description: RFC 3339 instant with explicit timezone; the body field `valid_at` takes precedence.

question.example: Welche Pflichtfelder hat die Maske M-2 und welche Rechte braucht der Benutzer dafür?

max_subqueries.description: Maximum number of searches, the original question included.

decomposition.description: Split the question by rule or by the configured model; an unusable model answer falls back to the rules.

collection.description: Must equal the `X-Collection` header when given.

200.description: Evidence packed into the token budget

truncated.description: More candidates existed than fitted the budget.

decomposition.description: The split actually used: `llm` only when the model parts were taken.

400.description: Invalid question, budget, filter or collection
